headline: Zoning amendment for RC-40 lot area rules (to be withdrawn) and street closure request for Middle Street Walk on December 12, 2026.
summary: The committee will consider CC#2026-012, a zoning amendment to minimum lot area requirements in the RC-40 Coastal Residential district, though this item is to be withdrawn. It will also review a special event application for street closures for the Middle Street Walk on December 12, 2026.
items: CC#2026-012 (Memhard): Amend GZO Sec. 3.2.1 'Dimensional Requirements for Single, Two-Family and Three-Family Dwellings' by increasing the minimum lot area per dwelling unit (sf) requirement for the RC-40 (Coastal Residential) zoning district by deleting '20,000 sf' and adding '40,000 sf' (continued from July 8, 2026) (to be withdrawn)
Special Event Application (#EVNT-26-58): Request for street closures for the Middle Street Walk on December 12, 2026
location: Harbormaster's Conference Room, 19 Harbor Loop #1, Gloucester, MA 01930
